name: smwpatches-yoshi-egg-patch
title: Yoshi Egg Patch V2
description:
When you come up to a yoshi egg while riding yoshi or while holding a baby yoshi the yoshi egg won't spawn a baby yoshi or a one up instead nothing will appear if you already have a yoshi or a baby yoshi but it'll still show the egg breaking.

Now checks for Baby Yoshies too.
